content.text:
This is a Go 1.26 CLI for **Entire**, which records AI-agent work alongside Git history without adding metadata commits to the user’s branch. It has ~1,382 Go files and 732 test files.

```text
AI agent hooks ──► Entire CLI ──► session/checkpoint strategy ──► Git-backed checkpoint refs
       │                  │                    │                         │
       │                  └─ Cobra commands    └─ Git hooks              └─ remote sync/fetch
       │
       └─ transcripts, session IDs, changed files

Git entire:// URL ──► git-remote-entire ──► auth/discovery ──► smart-HTTP Git transport
```

- **Entrypoints.** [`cmd/entire/main.go`](D:/PROJECTS/BTW_cli/cli_btw/cmd/entire/main.go) owns process lifecycle: version loading, signal cancellation, plugin dispatch, global error rendering, and the Cobra root command. [`cmd/git-remote-entire/main.go`](D:/PROJECTS/BTW_cli/cli_btw/cmd/git-remote-entire/main.go) is a separate Git remote-helper binary for `entire://` clone/fetch/push URLs.

- **CLI layer.** [`cmd/entire/cli/root.go`](D:/PROJECTS/BTW_cli/cli_btw/cmd/entire/cli/root.go:82) builds the command tree. Public areas include setup (`enable`, `configure`, `status`), sessions/checkpoints, agent management, auth, plugins, activity/search/recap/dispatch, and control-plane resources (org/project/repo/grant). Hidden commands implement Git hooks, MCP stdio support, telemetry, and trail/review infrastructure. Experimental commands are registered separately.

- **Agent integration.** [`cmd/entire/cli/agent`](D:/PROJECTS/BTW_cli/cli_btw/cmd/entire/cli/agent) provides the common agent abstraction, session/transcript handling, hook configuration, resume commands, permissions, token usage, and capability discovery. It supports built-in adapters and opt-in external `entire-agent-*` binaries via a stateless JSON-over-stdio protocol documented in [`external-agent-protocol.md`](D:/PROJECTS/BTW_cli/cli_btw/docs/architecture/external-agent-protocol.md).

- **Session and checkpoint lifecycle.** [`cmd/entire/cli/strategy`](D:/PROJECTS/BTW_cli/cli_btw/cmd/entire/cli/strategy) coordinates agent hooks and Git events. During a session it preserves state on a short-lived shadow branch; when the user commits, it condenses session data into a permanent checkpoint and adds an `Entire-Checkpoint` trailer to the user’s commit. The user branch receives no Entire-authored commits.

- **Storage architecture.** The lightweight public contract is [`api/checkpoint`](D:/PROJECTS/BTW_cli/cli_btw/api/checkpoint/doc.go); the Git implementation is [`cmd/entire/cli/checkpoint`](D:/PROJECTS/BTW_cli/cli_btw/cmd/entire/cli/checkpoint). New repositories default to one ref per checkpoint:
  `refs/entire/checkpoints/<shard>/<id>`.
  Each ref points to a commit whose tree contains checkpoint metadata, transcripts, and task records. There is also compatibility with the older single-branch backend, read routing across formats, optional mirror fan-out, on-demand fetching, and a durable queue for pending ref pushes. See [`ref-checkpoint-backend.md`](D:/PROJECTS/BTW_cli/cli_btw/docs/architecture/ref-checkpoint-backend.md).

- **Git transport.** [`internal/remotehelper`](D:/PROJECTS/BTW_cli/cli_btw/internal/remotehelper) contains the remote-helper protocol, smart-HTTP transport, replica selection/failover, debug logging, and Git protocol handling. `git-remote-entire` keeps stdout exclusively for Git’s protocol and sends diagnostics to stderr.

- **Upstream clients and auth.** [`internal/entireclient`](D:/PROJECTS/BTW_cli/cli_btw/internal/entireclient) contains cluster discovery, saved authentication contexts, token stores, HTTP utilities, and user-directory handling. [`internal/coreapi`](D:/PROJECTS/BTW_cli/cli_btw/internal/coreapi) is generated/typed control-plane API client code. The auth model maps each target host to a trusted identity-provider core, then uses the selected login context or `ENTIRE_TOKEN` for CI. The full policy is documented in [`upstream-host-resolution.md`](D:/PROJECTS/BTW_cli/cli_btw/docs/architecture/upstream-host-resolution.md).

- **Supporting concerns.** `redact/` provides transcript/PII/secrets redaction; `perf/` holds tracing helpers; `e2e/` supplies agent-aware end-to-end scenarios; `scripts/` and `mise-tasks/` provide installation, lint, CI, and release automation; `tools/complexity/` tracks complexity and duplication baselines. Development uses `mise`, as described in [`README.md`](D:/PROJECTS/BTW_cli/cli_btw/README.md).

I made no file changes. The worktree already has modifications to `.codex/hooks.json`, `.entire/settings.json`, `AGENTS.md`, and `CLAUDE.md`, plus an untracked `.entire/graph-agent.md`.
